title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E04 — Dangerous Game
The prized possessions of some of history's richest people haven't been castles, jewels, or fine art, but something more exotic, with the ability to bite back; meeting the monarchs and millionaires who spent their fortunes collecting wild animals.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E12 — We Built This City
The richest people who have ever lived had the resources and power to build entire cities from scratch.

Canals; naval fleet; the Great Wall of China; host Peter Weller.

title: Engineering an Empire
description:

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E01 — Party Animals
When it comes to throwing parties, history's richest figures have always picked going big over going home; meeting the mega-millionaires who hosted parties so epic that they're still being talked about today.

title: Quest for the Lost Ark
description: Professor Tudor Parfitt embarks on a harrowing journey of discovery to reveal where the Ark of the Covenant may be found and what it may look like.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E02 — Epic Collections
For the richest people to ever live, no price is too high to pay for an object of desire, no matter how expensive or strange it may be; fine art, rare books, and extremely large coconuts are all on display.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E03 — Expensive Tastes
Lavish dining is the epitome of living it up, and these are the mega-moneyed gourmands who spent jaw-dropping sums in pursuit of the rarest, the richest, and the most forbidden food and drink money could buy.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E03 — The Tet Offensive (1968)
The massive Tet Offensive catches the Americans by surprise; U.S. troops are under siege at Khe Sanh and Pleiku; Americans mount a counteroffensive, but the shock of the assault ignites anti-war fervor at home.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E04 — An Endless War (1968-1969)
The turmoil of 1968 helps Nixon win the presidency; the draft accelerates; Karl Marlantes endures bitter jungle fighting on Hill 484; Arthur Wiknik gets a grim introduction to combat.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E05 — A Changing War (1969-1970)
Troop withdrawals begin; Gery Benedetti patrols the Mekong Delta; James Anderson leads a battalion into Cambodia; Don DeVore struggles to survive a fierce night attack; Anne Purcell gets promising news about her husband.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E01 — Tank; Gatling Gun; Samurai Sword
Steering a World War II tank; Gatling gun's speed; power of the samurai sword.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E01 — The Beginning (1964-1965)
Operation Rolling Thunder roars across the skies over North Vietnam; American soldiers are outnumbered in the Ia Drang Valley.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E06 — Peace With Honor (1971-1975)
Bob Clewell's helicopter crew comes under intense fire; Joe Galloway returns to Vietnam; Barry Romo throws down his medals in protest; Anne Purcell awaits word of her husband's fate; the unification of Vietnam.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E02 — Search & Destroy (1966-1967)
American troops launch widespread search and destroy operations; body count becomes the measure of success in Vietnam; Charles Brown fights for survival on the bloody slopes of Hill 875 and at home; the American public begins to question strategy.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E12 — Branch Battle: Marines
Four Marines must forge one of the most versatile, and iconic combat knives in history: the KA-BAR.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E13 — Branch Battle: Navy
Four U.S. Navy officers must forge a multipurpose naval Mark 3 dive knife with metal from a giant anchor chain; two sailors return home to re-create the intricate and iconic naval officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E11 — Branch Battle: Air Force
In Round 2, four airmen from the U.S. Air Force must forge a bolo knife using the san mai technique to combine high carbon steel with helicopter parts; two smiths return home to forge an Air Force NCO sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E10 — Branch Battle: Army
Top bladesmiths from each branch of the U.S. military compete to earn a spot in a battle; four U.S. Army soldiers must forge a special forces V-42 stiletto; two smiths are dispatched to their home forges to build a U.S. Army officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E14 — Branch Battle: Finals
Tasked with replicating an iconic M3 Trench Knife from layered Damascus in only three hours; two servicemen persevere and head home to recreate a legendary sword: General George Washington's Lion-headed Cuttoe.

Two competitors are sent packing immediately after a surprise shoot-off; two shooters get a taste of WWII combat as they fire an M1 Carbine from a motorcycle sidecar.

description:

Chris Reed returns to instruct the shooters on several modern shotguns; one team crumbles in the team challenge; a head-to-head shotgun battle sends one contestant packing.
